current_controller_observations.finding: WP901 target-host workflow already uses a stable concurrency group with cancel-in-progress:false. Under current GitHub semantics, this preserves a running member while retaining at most one pending representative per group.
WP902 target-host characterization likewise uses a stable concurrency group with cancel-in-progress:false.
The stronger mainline WP1207 target-host workflow observed in this macrocycle has no concurrency key, so it does not inherit the same per-family pending-replacement behavior.

A redundant queued WP1207 branch run was actually cancelled after a no-op successor reused its concurrency group with cancel-in-progress:true. This demonstrates current controller/platform cancellation behavior at transport scope only.
The stronger mainline WP1207 target-host run remained queued at observation, so no target-runtime semantic result was available from that run.

external_pattern_fusion.bounded_meaning: One running plus at most one pending representative per semantic family; do not use cancel-in-progress:true by default for running exact-source probes.
Compatible request collapse is useful under worker scarcity but loses per-request results; F2 should collapse only semantically equivalent pending probes, not distinct experiments.
A pre-promotion freshness checkpoint can stop an older subject from overriding a newer representative, but F2 must use its own boundary fingerprint and evidence laws.
Runner online/busy/labels can prevent blind redispatch; absence of an authorized roster read remains UNKNOWN, never OFFLINE evidence.

distilled_architecture.name: RUNTIME_PROBE_LATEST_REPRESENTATIVE_PIPELINE

layers.rule: Derive a stable probe_family_id from the semantic promotion boundary/workpackage discriminator, not repository HEAD. Distinct experiments/falsifiers must have distinct families.
Use the controller platform's single-pending concurrency behavior for the same family. Preserve the currently running exact-source probe by default; replace only older PENDING representatives.

Where an authorized runner roster/status read exists, distinguish ONLINE_IDLE/ONLINE_BUSY/OFFLINE/UNKNOWN before dispatch. UNKNOWN is not OFFLINE. Do not redispatch merely because a previous job is queued.

Before expensive target execution or any effectful boundary, compare the queued subject with the current semantic boundary using RUNTIME_SUBJECT_BOUNDARY_FINGERPRINT. If closure is incomplete or changed, classify STALE_OR_UNKNOWN_BEFORE_EXECUTION and mint zero runtime credit.

If execution proceeds, bind exact controller run/job, F2 source/artifact, runner identity, boundary fingerprint, invocation, result and target receipt. Queue/cancellation metadata remains transport evidence only.
A green historical receipt cannot be composed with newer CI/source into current runtime credit unless the exact invariance/currentness gate passes at the claimed scope.

distilled_architecture.no_new_authority: This pipeline is a scheduling/evidence-linking projection over existing workpackage claims, controller runs and exact receipts. It must not become a second truth store, effect authority, completion authority or independent progress ledger.

counterhypotheses_and_limits: Per-family coalescing does not solve an offline/busy runner and cannot create runtime evidence.
A globally shared latest-wins group would be wrong because distinct workpackages and independent falsifiers must not cancel one another.
cancel-in-progress:true is unsafe as a default for effectful or unknown-outcome work and can destroy valuable already-running exact-source evidence.
A boundary fingerprint is only as sound as its verified dependency closure; incomplete closure must fail closed to UNKNOWN.
Runner labels/status are routing observations, not proof that clay-direct-dev exists or that the requested artifact executed.
The existing WP901/WP902 concurrency design means the correct delta is normalization/fusion, not a new external scheduler framework.
